field_contract.id: Stable curriculum identity. Must not encode a specific grammar topic because one outcome may depend on several topics.
field_contract.status: draft until pedagogically reviewed; approved only after year-level review.
field_contract.school_year_profile: Default Italian secondary-school year profile. It never overrides the student's official school programme.
field_contract.competence_axis: One primary competence axis from competence-axes.json.
field_contract.cefr_target: Expected task/language difficulty, not a substitute for the school syllabus.
field_contract.observable_outcome_it: Measurable statement describing what the learner can actually do. Avoid labels such as 'knows the Present Simple'.
field_contract.performance_levels_required: Subset of knowledge, controlled_performance and transfer. Transfer should normally be required for exit outcomes.
field_contract.prerequisite_outcome_ids: Stable v2 outcome dependencies. Do not use topic keys here.
field_contract.required_topic_keys: Existing Recovery grammar/language-system topics that are necessary evidence inputs for this outcome.
field_contract.recommended_topic_keys: Useful supporting topics that are not hard prerequisites.
field_contract.vocabulary_domains: Named lexical domains needed for successful performance. Use [] when not applicable.
field_contract.assessment_modes: Permitted evidence collection modes from assessment-modes.json.
field_contract.evidence_requirements: Minimum evidence shape for mastery; numeric scoring thresholds belong to readiness-policy.json, not here.
field_contract.programme_requirement: Whether the outcome is default_core, default_if_assessed, or programme_dependent for this year profile.
field_contract.blocking_candidate: Whether later readiness policy is allowed to make this outcome a blocking gate when required by the school programme. This field does not itself define the threshold.
field_contract.transfer_not_applicable: Optional boolean exception. Must be justified in notes if true.
field_contract.notes: Optional implementation/pedagogy notes that do not change the observable outcome.

field_contract.minimum_distinct_assessment_modes: Integer >= 1. Diversity of evidence, not number of individual questions.
field_contract.requires_controlled_production: Boolean. True when recognition is insufficient to demonstrate the outcome.
field_contract.requires_transfer_evidence: Boolean. Normally true for year-exit outcomes.
field_contract.requires_unseen_or_mixed_context: Boolean. True when the learner must choose language/strategy without the target being announced.

authoring_rules: Write outcomes as observable performance, not content coverage.
Do not create one outcome per grammar topic by default; combine language-system knowledge when the real competence is integrated.
Do not put translation_it_en or cumulative_school_test in competence_axis; those are assessment modes.
Do not mark an outcome default_core merely because the language point is common. Default core means it is expected in the robust year profile unless the student's official programme says otherwise.
Every default_core exit outcome should normally require transfer evidence.

If writing, listening or functional communication is not assessed by a particular school programme, the programme override may remove those outcomes from readiness without deleting them from the year profile.
Do not set numeric readiness thresholds here. Thresholds and compensation/gating rules belong to readiness-policy.json.
Do not add new Recovery topic keys while authoring year outcomes. Missing topic/content needs are recorded later in gap-analysis.json.

example.label_it: Gestire presente, passato e futuro di base in contesto
example.observable_outcome_it: Lo studente sceglie e produce forme verbali di base coerenti con riferimenti temporali chiari in frasi, brevi dialoghi e compiti misti senza che il tempo verbale venga indicato in anticipo.
